# neoshowcase_current_user (Data Source)

Returns the user configured for this NeoShowcase provider instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "neoshowcase_current_user" "this" {}

output "neoshowcase_user_id" {
  value = data.neoshowcase_current_user.this.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is an administrator.
- `avatar_url` (String) User avatar URL.
- `id` (String) NeoShowcase user ID.
- `name` (String) NeoShowcase user name.
